notes.title: Major Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We've just posted a well needed update.

Changelog:

-Replaced controller meshes with "hands"

-Fixed some objects not making sounds

-Fixed some objects spamming their collision sounds

-Fixed a lot of performance issues

-Slightly improved clarity of the graphics

-Added a splash screen

-Resized the keypad to be easier to use

-Fixed game not closing when exited through SteamVR menu

-Several dozen misc fixes/tweaks


Hope you all enjoy!

notes.title: Oculus Rift Support and other changes (Update 1.2)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Thanks again for all the feedback on The Cabin. We hope you're enjoying it!

Today we are releasing official Oculus Rift support!

Please note, this is still a roomscale game. Oculus users must have Oculus Touch and 360 degree tracking. Although 2 cameras will work, we recommend you have 3 for perfect tracking. 

In addition, we have made the following changes:

-better alligned vive controllers
-slight performance bump in last level

Unfortunately, there are some known issues:

-There is still some noticable lag in the final room. Still trying to fix that up.
-Rift mode may stutter. Still looking into this.

notes.title: Out now!
notes.content:
We've officially released The Cabin: VR Escape the Room. Thanks for your patience and tolerance to the small delay. We hope you enjoy the game. 

As a bonus, we are launching the VR Escape Bundle that comes with The Gleam and The Cabin at  a discounted price. Although playing The Gleam isn't necessary to play The Cabin, there are a few easter eggs hidden in the game that connect the lore between them. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/526750/'


Again, thanks so much for the support and a huge thank you to our beta testers. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27100529/2e3b36e68799164eec677932eab04f4a90438fc1.png[/img]

notes.title: Short Delay - January 2017
notes.content:
Hello!

Here at Blue Entropy Studios, we are striving to create great experiences for VR. We believe it is the future of gaming. 

Unfortunately, we ran into a few complications at our recording studio that caused us to fall a little behind schedule. Instead of releasing this month, we will be releasing in the beginning of January 2017. 

Although this is unfortunate, this gives us an opportunity to improve the game and make sure it's perfect for release. 

We hope you all understand! We look forward to a providing a wonderful experience.

Best regards from all of us at Blue Entropy Studios. Have a wonderful holiday. :)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27100529/2e3b36e68799164eec677932eab04f4a90438fc1.png[/img]
